name: wave2
objective: Turn replicated two-stream gain into a tested submission candidate and screen sentinel/complement ideas.

decisions.two_stream: Replicated positive, start full-data seed3 and native package.
decisions.online_norm: Positive train-HO, uncertain valid; retain research candidate, no full retrain yet.
decisions.bootstrap_card4: Withdraw original novelty claim: existing distill_boot_h already checks next_label_change > t+h. No duplicate experiment.
decisions.sentinel: No robust advantage over equal-dimension zero control; do not promote.
decisions.complement: Positive train-HO, slightly negative vs direct FT on valid; do not include in submission. Future research only.

replication.caveat: Conditional intervals on reused model artifacts; not unseen-domain certainty.

experiments.feature_definition: a5-a7 <= -5.19 treated as missing; retain indicators, replace sentinel numeric by 0, append log1p consecutive missing age. Zero control appends same six zero columns and keeps original raw values.
experiments.recipe: raw-view h128, composite train-half0 + valid folds1/2/3; same 4ep Muon parent +2ep full FT
experiments.primary: blend(age pair)-blend(zero pair), fixed component weight .2

experiments.recipe: 2ep full FT from same cmp_fullft seed checkpoint; only chain-excluded train-half1 fit subset; no new valid labels used in fit
experiments.loss: |clip(y)| * ((.8*B+.2*f-y)/.2)^2; direct control uses weighted MSE on original y; propensity weights identical
experiments.teacher_provenance: Known learned mixture teachers excluded fit/hold chains. Organizer baseline training lineage not independently certified.

experiments.recipe: Full train+valid 4ep Muon x6 +2ep full valid FT, architecture twostream h128x2 per stream
experiments.export: Exact block-diagonal embedding into dense GRU256; legacy native inference engine, no new C++ source.

primary_domains: valid fold0 without known training-chain overlap
reserved residual hold chains from train-half1
validation.feature_causality_test: PASS prefix-invariance, input immutability, missing age resets
validation.complement_loss_test: PASS gradient equality with unconstrained residual targets

infrastructure.datasphere: Native CPU audit with only 6.1MB inputs; default Ubuntu image rejected existing GLIBC2.36 binary; retry using python:3.11-slim-bookworm per official docker config docs.

delivery.change: replace public incumbent raw pair coefficient .25 by full-data twostream seed3 coefficient .25, keep other components
delivery.public_submission: not submitted; both ZIPs downloaded and CRC/hash verified

paired_runtime.caveat: Same-harness relative timing, calibrated to recorded 37m51s incumbent run. Not a measured scorer runtime for new packages.

delivery.full_runtime_conservative_gate: failed historical upper-ratio screen (56.1 min), but fresh relative timing to scored incumbent projects 43.4 min
delivery.lite_runtime_conservative_gate: passed 50-minute projection screen (46.8 min upper); paired incumbent timing projects 36.3 min
delivery.status: complete; full and lite packages prepared, paired timing and native correctness audits done
